Price Bid Breakdown Structure (Slab-wise Rates): · This bid is invited on a Custom Bid Model for Goods Transport Service from RINL Kochi Stockyard (7/151, Temple road, Vidakuzha, Kalamassery, Ernakulam, KERALA, PINCODE: 683106) to a ny location in Kerala State. · The bidder must mandatorily provide a detailed price break-up according to the 4 Distance Slabs as specified in the uploaded Excel Template. · The 4 Slabs and their approx Indicative Quantities are defined as follows: o Slab 1: > 100 km upto 150 km (Indicative Qty: 24,000 MT) o Slab 2: > 150 km upto 200 km (Indicative Qty: 24,000 MT) o Slab 3: >200 upto 250 km (Indicative Qty: 24,000 MT) o Slab 4: >250 km (Indicative Qty: 24,000 MT) 2. Basic Rate Criteria (Excluding GST): · All unit rates quoted by the bidder in Column E (Unit Rate (Rs.) - Per MT) must be strictly exclusive of GST (Base Price Only). · Applicable GST percentage must be selected by the bidder separately on the GeM portal as per stand ard GeM guidelines. Any inclusion of GST within the Excel sheet unit rates will lead to immediate com mercial rejection of the bid. 3. Mandatory Submission & Formula Matching: · It is mandatory for all participating bidders to download the provided Excel format, fill in their respe ctive Unit Rates for all 4 slabs in Column E, and upload the completed file in the Financial Document / Excel Upload section. · The calculation formula for each slab row must be followed as Total Amount (Rs.) = Indicative qty (MT) * Unit Rate (Rs.) * Distance Considered (Km) (Column G = D * E * F). · The Grand Total calculated at the bottom of the uploaded Excel sheet must exactly match the total l ump-sum price quoted by the bidder on the GeM Portal dashboard. In case of any mathematical mism atch, the buyer reserves the right to take appropriate action including rejection. 4. Disqualification Criteria: · Bidders who fail to upload this slab-wise price break-up document or leave any slab rate blank/zero in Column E will be treated as non-responsive and will be technically/financially disqualified without

any further clarification. 5. Other Terms and Conditions: · Only Empaneled Transporters are eligible to participate in the Bidding and Reverse Aucti on. · Lifting reports, vehicle wise should be sent to the issuing branch by the transporter on weekly basis through email. Transporter should ensure MTC along with the consignment. · Transporters are required to go through Scope of Work. .
